name: 華國媛
objective: The course introduces nanomaterials and their preparation processes (including chemical method and physical methods). Future development and applications are also discussed. This course will cover the following topics:1. Introduction of nanomaterials and Nano-chemistry; 2. Nanomaterials: structure and analysis; 3. Quantum mechanics; 4. Nanomaterials: self-assembly; 5. Nanomaterials: simulation; 6. Carbon-based nanomaterials; 7. Advanced synthesis and processing 8. Growth and application of semiconductor nanoparticles; 9. SEG & ESG prospective.
schedule:
Week        Title
1      Introduction on nanomaterials- nanotechnology in the ancient days and nature
2.    Nanomaterials: synthesis and structure
3.    Nanomaterials - nanocrystalline materials, nanocomposites, nanoporous material
4.   Nanomaterials- metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), inorganic-organic hybrid nanocomposites
5.    Properties of nanomaterials
6.    Electrical properties 
7.    Magnetic properties 
8.    Surface properties 
9.    Midterm Exam
10.  Quantum mechanics for beginners
11.  Optical properties
12.  Core-shell nanoparticles and gold nano-shells
13.   Carbon nanoworld - fullerenes, carbon nanotubes and graphene 
14.   Synthesis of nanomaterials at atomic scale
15.   Applications of nanomaterials and nanotechnology
16.    SDG of nanotechnology
17.    Safety Issues, Regulations, and Public Perception
18.    Final exam (Report)
scorePolicy:
Class participation (20%), Homework (20%), Midterm (30%), Final Report (30%)
課堂參與 20%、作業 20%、期中考 30%、期末報告 30%

Policy on Usage of AI:
1. Fact-Checking Professional Knowledge and Data
2. Prohibit Blind Faith in AI Outputs:  Any physicochemical properties of nanomaterials, chemical reaction formulas, structural characterizations, experimental data, or regulatory standards in the report must be based on textbooks or peer-reviewed academic journals.
3. Trace Original Literature: All sources listed in the references must be manually retrieved and verified for authenticity.
